predictions.text: I predict that the death toll from drone strikes in the Abyei area and other conflict zones in Sudan will rise to at least 220 by the end of Thursday, 29 October 2026, with the Sudanese Army and the Rapid Support Forces continuing their operations in the region.
I predict that the United States, Russia, and Ukraine will continue their peace talks, but no formal agreement will be reached by the end of Thursday, 29 October 2026.
I predict that Nigeria will report two more cases of Ebola virus, both involving health workers treating the first patient.

I predict that the investigation into the 2022 San Antonio migrant deaths will lead to the charging and arrest of at least one more suspect by the end of Thursday, 29 October 2026, bringing the total number of those charged to at least two.
I predict that the Saudi Public Investment Fund will finalize the sale of Electronic Arts and announce the new ownership structure in Canada.

I predict that protests and public sentiment in Iran and neighboring countries will continue to put pressure on governments to maintain lower fuel prices, with clashes between protesters and security forces occurring in at least two cities across Iran by the end of Thursday, 29 October 2026.
I predict that the United Kingdom will deploy RAF Typhoons to support Saudi Arabia in defending against Houthi attacks.
I predict that the Martian Moons eXploration spacecraft successfully reaches orbit around Phobos.
I predict that the legal challenges will not succeed in overturning the approval, and the maritime boundary agreement between Libya (GNA) and Turkey will remain in effect.
I predict that South Korea will issue a statement expressing concern over the handling of the North Korean soldiers by Ukraine, but will not take any additional actions against Ukraine.
